quarterly_data.quarter: QumulusAI press release: QumulusAI Signs $240.9 Million in New AI Inference Customer (09-29-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: QumulusAI signed two three-year take or pay agreements with AI inference customers (not named) with combined contracted value of $240.9 million, covering more than 2,000 NVIDIA Blackwell B300 GPUs across two dedicated clusters; both are second agreements, taking the two customers' combined contracted commitments past $344 million. (1) $211.9 million, three years, with an AI inference platform for large language, vision and speech models - follows the $71.9 million agreement of July 28, 2026, bringing that customer's commitments to more than $283 million; capacity targeted for turnover in early 2027. (2) $29.1 million, three years, with a generative-AI inference platform for image and video models - follows the $32 million, two-year agreement of July 23, 2026, bringing its commitments to more than $61 million; capacity expected to be turned over in December 2026. The $240.9 million covers the initial terms only: the larger agreement has two one-year extension options valued at $70.6 million each (total potential value $353.1 million over five years) and the smaller one a two-year extension option valued at $19.4 million (total potential $48.4 million); the options may or may not be exercised and are excluded from the commitments.
quarterly_data.figure: $240.9 million contracted value (three-year terms); more than 2,000 B300 GPUs; combined commitments of the two customers past $344 million; total potential value $401.6 million with extensions

quarterly_data.quarter: QumulusAI press release: QumulusAI Signs $240.9 Million in New AI Inference Customer (09-29-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: CEO Michael Maniscalco: both customers came back to commit to three more years; 'Inference platforms are planning capacity years out now, and they are backing those plans with cash. That lets us place GPUs against signed contracts rather than against forecasts.'
